post.description: Optional Idempotency-Key: a replay returns the stored turn response. Processing order: refresh-if-stale, classify (schema validated, one retry), safety precedence, bounded tool loop (TOOL_CALL_CAP_PER_TURN), grounding check, persist, audit. Whole-message HTTP response; latency depends on provider (observational p95 target 8 s in LIVE). Provider failure after the retry returns 200 with safe_state AI_UNAVAILABLE, a safe message with the Talk to a human option, and an AI_FAILURE_FALLBACK escalation. If the audit write fails for a material output the response is 200 with safe_state AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE and no proposal. Tool cap reached: safe_state TOOL_CAP_REACHED and an AI_FAILURE_FALLBACK escalation. Sensitive intents (FINANCIAL_HARDSHIP, DISPUTE, REQUEST_HUMAN, vulnerability_detected, special_request != NONE, PAYMENT_PLAN before Slice 2, UNKNOWN after clarifications) return a respectful holding message, handoff populated, no proposal. In a HANDED_OFF conversation replies are templated holding messages without a provider call for that topic.

post.description: OPEN cases pass through IN_REVIEW implicitly (two audit events). APPROVE of EXCEPTIONAL_ARRANGEMENT re-validates authority and freshness then creates the arrangement through the arrangement domain service with exactly the customer's requested terms. MODIFY (exceptional arrangements only) creates a pending ARRANGEMENT proposal the customer must confirm (D-041). ESCALATE takes only a whitelisted escalate_reason; the routing service picks the destination, the case becomes RE_ROUTED and a new OPEN case is created (parent_case_id set). release_suppression true releases hardship or vulnerable suppression and clears the vulnerability flag. Replays with the same Idempotency-Key return the original DecisionResult (replayed true).

field.description: Dotted request field path, null for non-field problems

ErrorBody.description: Error content. code is the coarse category, reason_code the precise deterministic reason.

correlation_id.description: Same value as the X-Correlation-Id response header

details.description: Zero or more details; multiple violations are all listed, primary reason_code is the first by fixed precedence

alternatives.description: Deterministic valid alternatives (for example valid amount and date ranges) when a rule rejects input

context.description: Error-specific context: refreshed_context, current_version, escalation_case_id, permitted_paths, retry_after_seconds

policy_version.description: PolicyRuleSet version used, when a rule decision was involved

status.description: Always ok when the process is up

session_token.description: Opaque token, returned only by POST /api/session; send as X-Demo-Session

Factor.description: One contributing factor of the deterministic priority score.

value.description: Input value as string (Decimal, integer or enum name)

normalized_value.description: Value after normalization, 0 to 1, 4 decimal places

contribution.description: Weighted contribution, 2 decimal places; contributions sum exactly to the score

factors.description: Ordered by contribution descending then factor_id

human_treatment.description: True when dispute, hardship, vulnerable flag or open escalation applies

automated_treatment_suppressed.description: True when automated treatment is suppressed

as_of.description: Snapshot as-of time (null means freshness UNKNOWN)

vulnerability_flag.description: Set by a VULNERABLE_CUSTOMER case until a human decision releases it

undisputed_overdue_amount.description: Overdue amount excluding items under active dispute

product_attributes.description: CARD: credit_limit, minimum_payment_due. PERSONAL_LOAN: original_principal, term_months, monthly_installment (money strings)

DelinquentItem.description: An overdue component that can be disputed.

disputed.description: True while an unresolved dispute references it

source_id.description: Case, hardship, dispute id or customer id

automated_treatment_suppressed.description: Automated treatment suppressed (account level or item level)

contact_allowed.description: Whether another contact attempt is allowed now

PayableOption.description: A payable amount returned by the deterministic service.

consistent.description: False when the record is inconsistent

DeterministicBlock.description: All rules-engine output, labelled Rules engine in the UI.

status.description: OK or POLICY_UNAVAILABLE (priority is then null, no eligibility granted)

Recommendation.description: AI next-best-action, labelled AI-generated in the UI.

rationale.description: Rationale text, grounded (figures only from services)

referenced_factor_ids.description: Factor ids the rationale relies on

status.description: GENERATED, SAFE_FALLBACK, HUMAN_REVIEW_ONLY, AI_UNAVAILABLE or NOT_GENERATED

record_version.description: Record version the recommendation was generated against

officer_decision.description: ACCEPTED or OVERRIDDEN once an officer decided

status.description: Latest status; AI_UNAVAILABLE shows the manual-workflow banner

cumulative_paid.description: Qualifying successful simulated payments counted so far

PaymentEvent.description: Simulated payment outcome. No real payment ever occurs.

ArrangementOption.description: An eligible arrangement option computed by the rules engine.

final_installment_amount.description: Last installment absorbing remainder; schedule sums exactly to total_amount

customer_statement.description: Redacted customer statement excerpt, max 500 chars

item_id.description: Disputed item; null means whole overdue amount

badge.description: Escalated - human review when any case is OPEN, IN_REVIEW or AWAITING_INFORMATION, else null

RecommendationDecisionRequest.description: Officer accepts or overrides an AI recommendation.

valid.description: True when creation would pass validation

reason_codes.description: ZERO_AMOUNT, NEGATIVE_AMOUNT, OVER_BALANCE, OVER_PRECISION, BELOW_MIN_AMOUNT, PAST_DATE, OUTSIDE_WINDOW, CONFLICTING_ACTIVE_ITEM, DISPUTED_ITEM

promised_amount.description: Decimal string, at most 2 dp, positive

promised_date.description: Between today and today plus ptp.window_days

interaction_reference.description: int_ or conv_ id belonging to the account

record_version.description: record_version from the Customer 360 snapshot the officer saw

ConversationCreateRequest.description: Start a conversation on one of the customer's own accounts.

account_id.description: Must belong to the bound customer, else 404

content.description: Text; assistant text is grounded or templated

PaymentTerms.description: Terms of a simulated payment proposal.

simulated_label.description: Constant Simulated payment - no real money moves

ExceptionRequestTerms.description: Terms of an exceptional-arrangement request submission.

notice.description: Constant: This request needs human review and is not approved

Proposal.description: A deterministic, customer-visible proposal awaiting explicit confirmation (D-041).

terms_hash.description: sha256 hex of canonical terms; echoed in the confirm request

summary.description: Templated summary built from service output

record_version.description: Record version the proposal is valid for

expires_at.description: Clock time after which it is EXPIRED

ChatTurnResponse.description: Whole-message response for one turn (no streaming).

handoff.description: Present when a human handoff exists

safe_state.description: NONE unless a fail-closed state applies

ConversationCreateResult.description: New conversation with AI disclosure greeting.

greeting.description: First assistant message, labels include AI_DISCLOSURE

ConfirmRequest.description: Explicit customer confirmation of a displayed proposal.

terms_hash.description: terms_hash of the proposal as displayed; mismatch gives PROPOSAL_INVALID

ConfirmOutcome.description: What the domain service created (exactly one non-null).

assistant_message.description: Templated confirmation; contains the word simulated for payments
Message that a human colleague will follow up

replayed.description: True when an existing OPEN case was returned

EscalationListItem.description: Row of the escalation list / review queue.

age_hours.description: Whole hours since creation by Clock

items.description: Sorted by priority (URGENT first) then age (oldest first)

policy_version.description: Policy version used for aging thresholds

queues.description: One entry per queue visible to the persona

ExceptionAuthority.description: Whether the officer may approve an exception.

EligibilityResult.description: Deterministic arrangement eligibility for the case's account.

reason_code.description: Eligibility failure reason, for example CONFLICTING_ACTIVE_ITEM

options.description: Eligible options (the only set MODIFY may choose from)

RuleResults.description: Deterministic rule results shown separately from AI content.

action.description: ReviewAction value or COMPLIANCE_DECISION or START_REVIEW

permitted.description: False means the UI hides or disables it

ReviewDecision.description: A recorded human decision or transition.

release_suppression.description: Whether this decision released hardship or vulnerable suppression

overrode_ai.description: REJECT or MODIFY on a case whose source is AI

EscalationDetail.description: Full case for review (conversation, AI recommendation and rule results separated).

available_actions.description: Permitted actions for this persona now

compliance_outcomes.description: Non-empty only for COMPLIANCE_REVIEW cases viewed by COMPLIANCE_RISK

StartReviewRequest.description: Claim a case (OPEN to IN_REVIEW) or resume (AWAITING_INFORMATION to IN_REVIEW).

ModificationRequest.description: Change the proposal within deterministic boundaries.

option_id.description: Must be in EligibilityResult.options; free-form amounts are rejected

action.description: APPROVE, REJECT, MODIFY, REQUEST_MORE_INFORMATION or ESCALATE

expected_version.description: Case version the reviewer saw; mismatch gives 409 VERSION_CONFLICT

reason.description: Mandatory (1-1000 chars) for REJECT, MODIFY, ESCALATE and APPROVE

escalate_reason.description: Required for ESCALATE; must be in routing.reviewer_escalation_reasons

release_suppression.description: Default false; only meaningful for HARDSHIP and VULNERABLE cases

arrangement.description: Created by APPROVE of an exceptional arrangement

customer_proposal.description: Pending customer proposal created by MODIFY

suppression_lifted.description: True only when RESOLVED with an outcome

ai_output.description: Redacted AI output (invalid output stored here too)

items.description: Ordered by timestamp then sequence ascending

Kpi.description: One KPI with definition and label.

value.description: Decimal string, integer string or null when not computable

claim_status.description: NOT_APPLICABLE, OBSERVATION_ONLY (fewer than 30 LIVE cases), PASS or FAIL

source_note.description: Dataset version, run id or synthetic-data note

AiQualityKpis.description: AI KPIs, MOCK and LIVE never mixed.

mock.description: MOCK regression results, never evidence of model quality

live.description: LIVE evaluation results; empty when no LIVE run exists

live_run_available.description: Whether at least one LIVE EvalRun exists

KpiResponse.description: KPI tree (BRD 4.5). Deferred KPIs are absent.

llm_mode.description: MOCK or LIVE, shown as text

refresh_snapshots.description: Default true: run the simulated core sync (as_of, DPD, version) after advancing

payment_event.description: Event with simulated=true and source DEMO_CONTROL

PersonaHeader.name: X-Persona
PersonaHeader.description: Demo persona (not authentication). One of the four Persona values.

DemoSessionHeader.name: X-Demo-Session
DemoSessionHeader.description: Opaque token from POST /api/session; required when X-Persona is CUSTOMER (binds customer_id server-side).

CorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-Id
CorrelationId.description: Optional; generated when absent; always echoed in the response header.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required on consequential operations. Same key and same body returns the original result; same key and different body gives 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.
